commonPrompt: Create ONE original landscape 3:2 realistic candid lifestyle photograph for a lightweight people-counting web game. Use a wide shot with clear separate small-to-medium human figures distributed naturally through the scene, mostly side views, three-quarter rear views or backs. Nobody poses, lines up for a photo, or looks directly at the viewer. All subjects are fictional adults in ordinary modest everyday clothing; vary appearances naturally between scenes. Natural daylight or bright interior lighting, restrained realistic colors, simple background details, gently photographic texture. Every counted adult's head and body silhouette must be visible and individually distinguishable, without overlap hiding another person. Total people means ALL humans anywhere in the entire image. No additional background people, distant people, staff, face-like mannequins, portraits, posters depicting people, visible occupants in vehicles, or human reflections. Do not crop anyone's head. Keep the complete counted scene within the middle 90% of the frame. No celebrities, brands, logos, readable text, signs, numbers, watermark, borders, panels or collage. Only ordinary non-sensitive public leisure locations; no medical, religious, political, military, police, detention, intimate or school settings. This must be a standalone complete photograph, not a game UI.
